info.title: TruckerFetch Pro API
info.description: Owner-scoped carrier, authority and observed-insurance research. All data operations require active Pro. Additional scopes, historical grants, source availability and current suppressions apply. Source observation, effective dates, edition dates and renewal estimates represent distinct facts.

Returns the latest published edition with its original source date, which can be older during a source delay. May publish already-due daily editions using the server clock and queue normal opt-in notifications.

post.description: Requires active Pro and an owner-scoped REST bearer key. Required scopes: exports:write, contacts:read. Creates an owner-scoped CSV job pinned to an authorized selection and published release. Save the payload and Idempotency-Key before submission. REST uses the user's explicit selection authorization and has no MCP browser-approval step; hosted MCP additionally requires owner approval through confirmation_url and an identical retry with the same key. Renewal selections additionally require insurance:read and insurance availability; edition selections require current historical access. The sample selection is dashboard-only.

post.description: Requires active Pro and an owner-scoped REST bearer key. Required scopes: data:read, archive:unlock. Requires account-owner approval in both REST and hosted MCP. Submit the exact edition date with a saved Idempotency-Key; on confirmation_required, give the owner the returned confirmation_url and retry the identical request with the same key after approval. Opening a new historical date can consume the account allowance. The latest edition is included; historical dates outside the rolling 90 Eastern calendar dates return archive_expired even if opened earlier.
